key_insight: In Ti₇₆Nb₂₂Al₂, mutually incompatible martensitic deformation gradients can support a boundary-preserving microstructure through a degenerate T₁₂ configuration.
engineering_relevance: The analysis links transformation-strain compatibility to interface formation and macroscopic shape preservation in a shape-memory alloy.
method: Apply the moving mask approximation to 12 martensitic gradients rank-one connected to austenite.
Establish a degenerate T₁₂ configuration under unit middle eigenvalue and volume preservation, with microstructures supported on only 8 gradients.
Analyze near-compatibility between gradient pairs and relate it to observed interfaces.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experimental confirmation of the predicted identity macroscopic deformation gradient and more frequent observation of interfaces between more nearly compatible pairs.
watch_item: The construction assumes exact unit middle eigenvalue and volume preservation; no deformation with the same boundary condition has its gradient in the finite set almost everywhere.
paper_title: Complex Martensitic Microstructures in ${\rm Ti}_{76}{\rm Nb}_{22}{\rm Al}_{2}$
